sources.snippet: Football-Object-Detection Description This project follows the tutorial by Code In a Jiffy in their video Build an AI/ML Football Analysis system with YOLO, OpenCV, and Python. The goal is to build a football analysis system with YOLO and understand more on how to use OpenCV and how to utilize the data obtained.
